description: A small synthetic set: one fictional witness statement whose claims cover every verdict, a scope difference and a silent record. Every name is invented.

cases.title: Statement of a fictional logistics manager in a supply dispute

paragraphs: 1. I am the logistics manager of Kestrel Freight Ltd and I make this statement about the Orlan Mills contract.
2. The first consignment left our depot on 4 March 2024. It reached the Orlan Mills warehouse two days later.
3. We never received any complaint about damaged goods before the end of March 2024.
4. Our team delivered 120 pallets in total in March 2024. In my view our service that month was exemplary.
5. The invoice for the March deliveries was for EUR 18,400.
6. I was relieved when the contract was renewed, because I had worked hard on the account.
7. Orlan Mills paid the March invoice within 30 days of receiving it.
8. Our on-time delivery rate across all customers was 98 percent in 2024.
9. Every pallet we sent was packed to the specification Orlan Mills had agreed.

facts.text: Depot dispatch log records the first Orlan Mills consignment leaving on 4 March 2024.
Orlan Mills goods-in record shows the first consignment received on 6 March 2024.
Email from Orlan Mills to Kestrel Freight complaining that 14 pallets arrived with crushed corners.
Kestrel Freight delivery summary for March 2024 lists 120 pallets delivered to Orlan Mills.
Invoice KF-2024-031 to Orlan Mills for the March deliveries: EUR 18,400.
Kestrel Freight accounts ledger records invoice KF-2024-031 at EUR 21,400.
Orlan Mills received invoice KF-2024-031 on 3 April 2024 and paid it on 29 April 2024.
Kestrel Freight annual report: on-time delivery rate of 98 percent for its Orlan Mills account in 2024.
Orlan Mills quality note on the March consignments: packing "broadly to spec", strapping on some pallets queried, no finding made.
facts.interpretationNote: Whether the queried strapping breaches the agreed specification is not stated.

claims.quote: The first consignment left our depot on 4 March 2024.
claims.note: The dispatch log records the 4 March departure.

claims.quote: It reached the Orlan Mills warehouse two days later.
claims.note: 4 March plus two days is 6 March, the goods-in date.

claims.quote: We never received any complaint about damaged goods before the end of March 2024.
claims.note: A damage complaint was emailed on 21 March 2024.

claims.quote: Our team delivered 120 pallets in total in March 2024.
claims.note: The March delivery summary lists 120 pallets.

claims.quote: In my view our service that month was exemplary.
The invoice for the March deliveries was for EUR 18,400.
claims.note: The invoice says EUR 18,400; the ledger records the same invoice at EUR 21,400.

claims.quote: I was relieved when the contract was renewed, because I had worked hard on the account.
claims.note: The author's feelings; the record is not expected to speak to them.

claims.quote: Orlan Mills paid the March invoice within 30 days of receiving it.
Our on-time delivery rate across all customers was 98 percent in 2024.
claims.note: The 98 percent figure is for one customer, not all customers.

claims.quote: Every pallet we sent was packed to the specification Orlan Mills had agreed.
claims.note: The quality note finds packing broadly to spec but queries some strapping without a finding: it challenges "every pallet" without refuting it.
